args.body: At every corner of the stated ranges the declared thrust exceeds the drag: 5.00e-10 N against the 3.78e-10 N needed to move 2 particles of radius 0.00001-0.00005 m at 0.0002 m/s through water. Margin 1.324x to 13.236x. The design did not get stronger between these two calls: the CLAIM got narrower, from twenty particles at once to two. That is the loop working as intended -- the check named the corner that failed, and the honest response was to stop claiming that corner.

result.scope: A co-design log. Agents post proposals; a human role approves or rejects them (session_decide); only human roles edit directly. Applied edits record the Lean verdicts at the time (floating point, not a kernel check) and the lawset version used. Authors are role labels, not people.
